arxiv-2102-09493.creator: Raphaël Baena, Lucas Drumetz, Vincent Gripon, IMT Atlantique and Lab-STICC, name.surname@imt-atlantique.fr
arxiv-2102-09493.description: Abstract The field of Graph Signal Processing (GSP) has proposed tools to generalize harmonic analysis to complex domains represented through graphs. Among these tools are translations, which are required to define many others. Most works propose to define translations using solely the graph structure (i.e. edges).

arxiv-2212-05538.title: The overtone level spacing of a black hole quasinormal frequencies: a fingerprint of a local S ​ L ​ ( 2 , ℝ ) SL(2,\mathbb{R}) symmetry
arxiv-2212-05538.creator: Bernard Raffaelli
arxiv-2212-05538.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Bernard Raffaelli. The imaginary part of the quasinormal frequencies spectrum for a static and spherically symmetric black hole is analytically known to be equally spaced, both for the highly damped and the weakly damped families of quasinormal modes. Some interesting attempts have been made in the last twenty years to understand in simple ways this level spacing for the only case of highly damped quasinormal frequencies.

arxiv-2305-01878.title: Spatial regions, chaos bound and its violation
arxiv-2305-01878.creator: Zeqiang Wang a, Deyou Chen, a
arxiv-2305-01878.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Zeqiang Wang a, Deyou Chen, a. The influence of the angular momentum of the particle on the Lyapunov exponent has been studied. In this paper, we investigate influences of the charge and angular momentum of a particle around non-extremal and extremal Reissner-Nordström black holes with a scalar hair on the exponent, and find spatial regions where the chaos bound is violated for certain values of the black holes’ parameters.

arxiv-2310-20389.title: High-Resolution Reference Image Assisted Volumetric Super-Resolution of Cardiac Diffusion Weighted Imaging
arxiv-2310-20389.creator: Yinzhe Wu, Jiahao Huang, Fanwen Wang, Pedro Ferreira, Andrew Scott, Sonia Nielles-Vallespin, Guang Yang
arxiv-2310-20389.description: Abstract Diffusion Tensor Cardiac Magnetic Resonance (DT-CMR) is the only in vivo method to non-invasively examine the microstructure of the human heart. Current research in DT-CMR aims to improve the understanding of how the cardiac microstructure relates to the macroscopic function of the healthy heart as well as how microstructural dysfunction contributes to disease.

arxiv-2410-08609.title: Can a pseudoscalar with a mass of 365 GeV in two-Higgs-doublet models explain the CMS t ​ t ¯ t\bar{t} excess?
arxiv-2410-08609.creator: Chih-Ting Lu, Kingman Cheung, Dongjoo Kim, Soojin Lee, Jeonghyeon Song
arxiv-2410-08609.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Chih-Ting Lu, Kingman Cheung, Dongjoo Kim, Soojin Lee, Jeonghyeon Song. We investigate the recently reported t ​ t ¯ {t\bar{t}} excess by the CMS Collaboration within the framework of conventional Two-Higgs-Doublet Models (2HDMs). Considering all four types (I, II, X, and Y), we perform a comprehensive parameter space scan using the best-fit values for a pseudoscalar boson A A : M A = 365 M_{A}=365 GeV, Γ A / M A = 2 % \Gamma_{A}/M_{A}=2\% , and tan ⁡ β = 1.28 \tan\beta=1.28 .

arxiv-2507-22671.title: Designing for Self-Regulation in Informal Programming Learning: Insights from a Storytelling-Centric Approach Thanks:
arxiv-2507-22671.creator: Sami Saeed Alghamdi, Christopher Bull, Ahmed Kharrufa
arxiv-2507-22671.description: Abstract Many people learn programming independently from online resources and often report struggles in achieving their personal learning goals. Learners frequently describe their experiences as isolating and frustrating, challenged by abundant uncertainties, information overload, and distraction, compounded by limited guidance.

arxiv-2512-00585.title: Representations of the Grassmann Poisson superalgebras
arxiv-2512-00585.description: Abstract . We prove that every irreducible Poisson supermodule over the Grassmann Poisson superalgebra G n G_{n} over a field of characteristic different from 2 2 is isomorphic to the regular Poisson supermodule Reg ​ G n \mathrm{Reg}\,G_{n} or to its opposite supermodule. Moreover, every unital Poisson supermodule over G n G_{n} is completely reducible.

pmc-10647771.creator: Alfonso Lendínez-Jurado, Juan Pedro López-Siguero, Ana Gómez-Perea, Ana B Ariza-Jiménez, Icía Becerra-Paz, Leopoldo Tapia-Ceballos, Carmen Cruces-Ponce, José Manuel Jiménez-Hinojosa, Sonsoles Morcillo, Isabel Leiva-Gea, Charikleia Stefanaki, Brian Tomlinson

These have been most studied in adults and there are currently not many articles published in the pediatric population that establish their correlation with age of debut. pmc-12093608.title: Imaging findings of intrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma for prognosis prediction and treatment decision-making: a narrative review
pmc-12093608.creator: Jun Gu Kang, Taek Chung, Dong Kyu Kim, Hyungjin Rhee
pmc-12093608.description: Intrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma (iCCA) is a heterogeneous bile duct adenocarcinoma with a rising global incidence and a poor prognosis. This review aims to present a comprehensive overview of the most recent radiological research on iCCA, focusing on its histopathologic subclassification and the use of imaging findings to predict prognosis and inform treatment decisions.

pmc-12470294.title: Endotoxin’s Impact on Organism: From Immune Activation to Tolerance and Beyond
pmc-12470294.creator: Kacper Roszak, Konkonika Roy, Justyna Sobocińska, Paulina Spisz, Tomasz Jędrzejewski, Sylwia Wrotek
pmc-12470294.description: Endotoxin, a key component of Gram-negative bacterial membranes, remains a central focus in understanding host–pathogen interactions and immune modulation. In this review, we examine the multifaceted roles of endotoxin, with particular emphasis on how its structural variants modulate host immune recognition and inflammatory signalling.
